notes.content:

- Josh

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Triune Followers,

We’re absolutely cruising behind the scenes with our development of Eternal Tombs! There is so much work getting done, we are incredibly proud of how this game is shaping up. With that being said, we have an announcement:

[h1]Announcing: In-Game Maps![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/fb76fe5901bf3e0eaf10e60f1e778c2f52c14fd2.jpg[/img]

That’s correct. Eternal Tombs will now have in-game maps! That being said, we believe that exploration and immersion is a critical component of Eternal Tombs and we want to keep that for players who do not want a map in the game. In keeping with this vision, maps will be a vendor sold item within Mithir. You can choose to spend your platinum buying a map or decide that you want to explore without one. To ensure continued realistic immersion, we also decided to not put a player marker within each zone map. Players will need to read maps and match them up against landmarks within the game, so that feeling of exploration will still be a huge part of Mithir regardless of whether or not you choose to purchase a map. Also, one important thing of note is that not every zone will have a map. Tombs will be map-free, so exploring those dungeons will still have quite a bit of mystery and intrigue for you to discover.

[previewyoutube=V5uTyar9zP0;full][/previewyoutube]

Our goal over the coming months is to continue working toward getting people back into Mithir. We plan to release Eternal Tombs in a full release state. No early access, no paid alpha, no half-built game, nothing besides a full release is our mission. To that end, we’re pushing hard to develop and have a bunch of updates for each testing phase because we know how important it is to have solid testing rounds with a lot of content, so we can get as much tested as possible. A huge thank you to our testers and we appreciate all of you having patience as we continue building out Mithir.

Finally, be sure to follow our social media links below. We’re posting new screenshots multiple times a week of the game, so to get those updates, follow below.

- Josh
Creative Director

notes.title: 2024 Testing & Development Review
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6wDfFdBKIXw;full][/previewyoutube]

Triune Followers,

It’s been a very busy month. We’re diligently working hard on world polish, continued combat revamping, bug fixes, events, and continued buildout of mobs, abilities, gear, and so much more. We’re also now updating more content to social media platforms, so be sure to check follow us at one of the platforms below and our Discord for weekly screenshots, videos and information related to Eternal Tombs.

One of the most critical components of our development process is to ensure that we absolutely perfect combat. By having incredibly unique abilities that really emphasize the originality of our classes, we believe we have set the foundation for a game unlike any other MMO on the market. That being said, these abilities need to co-exist well with melee, range attacks, runestones and all other aspects of combat. We also want to ensure that you can customize and build out a class that you want to play. Want to be a Bombardier that has huge powerful ranged attacks and strong damage absorption? No problem. Maybe instead you want option to build a Bombardier that emphasizes runestones combined with explosive procs attached to your weapons to really unleash the DPS. Whatever your play style, we want to be able to support that within Eternal Tombs in a very fresh way. We continue to really value your feedback in this area and really appreciate all of you who have tested Eternal Tombs to help us dial this in.

In addition to a focus on play class play style, this month, we’ve been able to address multiple combat issues within the system. We believe we’ve eliminated the method of simply circling an enemy to avoid damage while continuously maximizing your damage. We’ve also address several bow issues that really made using it quite cumbersome and incredibly frustrating at times.

We look forward to showing you all of our updates in the coming months when we’re able to let everyone back into Mithir to test. Stay tuned as we progress forward and open these tests up again. We appreciate a great 2024 and your participation in our small low level tests and we are thrilled that we’ll be able to give you a strong taste of the full game in 2025 with a release date shortly on the horizon thereafter.

- Josh
Creative Director

notes.title: October Testing
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Thank you for helping us test Eternal Tombs! We’re pushing hard on lots of updates and this round of testing will help us with testing our combat overhaul.

As many of you know, our combat system was a bit unique with some controls that were not really standard. While interesting and fast paced, especially as players progressed, this required too much of a learning curve and wasn’t really comfortable to new players. We’ve overhauled much of the combat controls to be far more in-line with mainstream games and the results have been met with very positive feedback. We’re also working with swing timing, blocking, critical hits, AI, visual updates and more as part of this test! As we continue to refine combat, we look forward to having you jump in and give us your feedback in October.

[previewyoutube=xWTF8a5kk8I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


If you want to stay up-to-date with the latest details, be sure to join our discord and also appreciate you giving us a Wishlist on Steam as it is incredibly helpful for our exposure.

Thank you to everyone who continues to help us test and promote Eternal Tombs!

- Josh
Creative Director

notes.title: July Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/407db03cc1c111d900a73b080561181bbfdc0eaa.jpg[/img]

My Dear Triune Followers, 

Within the Oasis of Kir, the Vissal, a once powerful snake-like people continue to work on something incredibly dark and evil deep within a locked and mysterious temple. Born of blasphemous magical conjuring’s, the Vissal haven’t been seen for years, but they are devout and loyal followers of Dragnorox. Being created from the essence evil, they love and adore the wickedness of all that is foul within Mithir. They used to fiercely pursue the death of those who oppose Dragnorox, so be wary my friend, be sure to work in secret. Just because they haven’t been seen in many moons, doesn’t mean they are gone. Their lack of presence gives us confidence that there is much being built within the shadows. In fact, it is our sole focus to discover what they are working on behind the doors of the temple they have taken refuge within.  

Head to the Western shores of the Oasis and work with Balan to obtain a key to the temple. He has been working for some time on the secrets around getting a key. Between The Charbearers and their work on dealing with the magic items found there and his uncovered mysteries, we believe we are close to creating a key. 

Whether it be magic of unknown power and origin or some creature more foul than the old Dragon’s, there is much to discover within the Oasis. Head there quickly and may the Triune be with you.

- Elias

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/7602aacb9bae5911f3045259d593b98a0b031cdd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Zone Feature - Ashen Valley[/h2]

The Southeastern area of Ashen Valley is home to a Druid Occult loyal to Dragnorox. Their efforts to torture, slay and sacrifice Elves upon the altar of Dragnorox worship is one of the most vile practices within Mithir. Their efforts are hindered greatly by the efforts of The White Sky, a group seeking to save and rescue to the Elves from the Druids, the Vilem and Dragonorox’s other followers. Join The White Sky in Ashen Valley to bring home as many Elven brethren as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/407db03cc1c111d900a73b080561181bbfdc0eaa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/0aebc5b5ace6a94cec4149db04684365a19574c0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/3e53e4a17381c48f8ad02648c86441da679b6802.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/b685d2990fa7d30e3d9ec3776af2a0f18d88e699.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/47d6d9efc4b53ae87c51743d30f5ee7d4e44b4ec.jpg[/img]

[h2]Creature Feature - Ulfur[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/97e8d3c420fb01927398f1453f3bf0a293b4d9c6.jpg[/img]

The Ulfur are a wicked bloodthirsty aberration created by Malkor, a Councili Tenadaii member with an expertise on using magic to create new creatures and their foul deviations. 

The Ulfur will attack anyone who they see and will ravage their foes with their hardened antlers. Ulfur hides are known for their excellent toughness and malleability in crafting, so the reward in their death can often be worth the risk. 

[h2]Testing Update[/h2]

Hey Everyone,

Thank you so much for your patience during this build phase. After our first round of testing, there was a LOT to get done and this is easily our biggest milestone and development update. To make up for this large length of development time, we’re going to let you explore 5 new zones in the next test instead of the originally promised 3. You’ll be able dive into all sorts of new areas, mysteries, secrets, quests and events. There is so much to learn about Dragnorox, The Triune, Councili Tenadaii, The White Sky, The Charbearers, The Vilem, and so so much more. We’re really excited to push this next phase out as soon as possible. 

That being said, here is our tentative schedule: 

[u][b]August 1st [/b][/u] - Deploy Latest Patch and Update to our small group of early testers.
[u][b]Late August/Early September[/b][/u] - Run multiple and longer testing sessions for the public. 

I hate taking so long to let people back into the game, but it’s important that we deliver this to you correctly. We’ve built out some new server manager tools for stability (so we can run longer tests), so many bug fixes, zone updates, performance updates, and more. Eternal Tombs will be the one of the most fun and exciting MMORPG’s ever created and we’re committed to giving you the best experience possible. We want a full and exciting experience for you all that’s built upon a reliable technology stack, even as we test, so thank you for your patience and allowing us to build this world out for you.

- Josh
(Creative Director)

notes.title: May Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

A huge amount of work and changes has been done over the last month since our first test. We're adding/updating/deleting/revamping and continuing polish as we prepare for the next test. We can't wait to get you into Mithir again here soon. 

When will the next test be? We're not 100% sure at this point, but we're pushing incredibly hard to get it ready to go. Our goal is to get to bi-weekly testing sessions, however after the first test, we realized there's a LOT that needs to be updated to ensure that we are hitting the mark before we can start doing tests that frequently. We've already updated a LOT, but there's still quite a bit left. In addition to fixes/updates, we're also including three new zones in the next testing session:

[list]
[*] Tombs of Ashura
[*] Northmir
[*] The Oasis of Kir
[/list]

These zones are built for levels in the 10-20 range. So there'll be lots of new things to do for those of you who leveled quite quickly in the first test.

Stay tuned for further updates and don't forget to Wishlist us on Steam! It helps us out a ton. 

- Josh

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41648029/4ec8e332bbea1ccca2d84aa0d0832cbd01ab5356.png[/img]

Hey Everyone,

Hope everyone is having a great spring and good start to the summer!

I just wanted to provide a quick update on a few things as we continue to build out WoD. As you know we've been pretty quiet and that is because we are making significant progress toward launching our beta. We still have quite a ways to go, but we're making such great strides in every area of the game. Do not mistake our lack of communication over the last few months and in the coming months as lack of progress, but rather as a sign that our energy, effort and sweat is going into building WoD. Over the last few months we have built out and progressed in the following areas:

[list]
[*] Two Fully Completed Dungeon Builds
[*] Built out our entire leveling process
[*] Fixing bugs with looting corpse issues
[*] Built out the entire inventory system and crafting components
[*] Built out our server infrastructure and queue system for entering the game and hosting the game across multiple servers and regions.
[*] Completed all functionality related to armor display and stats. 
[*] Fixed issues with trade
[*] Built out our "Operation" prototype. More to come about this in the future. 
[*] Finished deploying our DM system to internal systems. 
[/list]

Anyway, as you can see we're making great progress and again, when the time is right, we're really excited to show everything off. We're still relatively unknown and that's ok for the moment. We know that when the time comes, we think we'll shock people with some of the unique systems and gameplay we've built. Thank you to everyone who has talked about us with your friends, streamers and people who you game with. Every little bit help us progress forward. 

In the meantime, if you have any questions, don't hesitate to jump into our discord. We try to communicate as much as possible along the way. 

Thank you everyone!

- Josh Caba
Creative Director

notes.title: Mount System & Combat Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Hope you've all had a great month!

Just wanted to send out a quick update here. Even though we're quiet, we're furiously working hard and forging ahead on multiple fronts! We're putting 99% of our efforts into actual development, so progress is moving very quickly. 

First off, we're continuing our combat re-build. As mentioned previously, our biggest hangup with the design of WoD so far has been combat. To be straight forward, we really love classic style MMO's with tab targeting, but it very quickly can turn into a pure grind and is super repetitive. This was clearly how WoD was shaping up in terms of combat. We realized that we fell in love with old school MMO's for reasons far different than their combat systems. Despite our best efforts, it truly was the only part of WoD that we just couldn't get right. We felt like we had come up with some really good ideas and decently engaging combat with our tab target system, it still just came back to the feeling of being a grind and really not how we wanted to push the genre forward. So we knew we needed something different.

We took a step back and started brainstorming about what we wanted instead of copying other systems or games. We had multiple core tenets that we wanted to ensure were in our combat system, they were:  [list][*]Hard[*]Unique[*]Dangerous[*]Gear being a huge factor[*]Strong Mouse/Keyboard skills[*]Highly intellectual[/list]

We were building a new MMO with unique ideas to help push the genre forward. After several months of prototyping and experimentation, we finally believe we have come up with a pretty innovative combat design that will meet every one of these requirements. Let me tell you, it is incredibly fun. Fights are long, complicated, fast paced and very rewarding. I have no hesitation in saying that it is easily the best combat system of any MMO. After we finish up all of our changes, we'll be doing a full reveal. So standby for that.

In addition to that, we've wrapped up our mount system as you can see in the screenshot above. Yes, we're launching with a full mount system on day 1. Morgath is a huge world and it'll take some help in getting across it. We also have other ways to help with travel that we'll reveal in the coming months. 

Other updates, we've re-built our character editor system to further suit our armor and gear. We thank you all for your help on our discord in sending us messages and giving us ideas on gear naming. We really appreciate it! We've used a lot of them and we'll continue to do so. Building out gear is quite a long and tedious process, so plenty of months ahead of working on this. 

Finally, I'll leave everyone with one final note: Merry Christmas!!! We hope you have a great December and we'll see you again next month!

-Josh 
Creative Director
